name: webhookvault-skills
description: Agent Skills for receiving, verifying, testing and debugging webhooks, and for working with WebhookVault from an AI assistant.

plugins.name: webhookvault
plugins.description: Work with WebhookVault from an assistant: debug missing webhooks, test receivers, inspect deliveries, check verification, triage watchdogs, design transformations, set up endpoints, assert webhooks in CI.

plugins.name: webhook-engineering
plugins.description: Provider-neutral webhook engineering: signature verification with tested Node.js, Python and C# code, and the patterns a reliable receiver needs.

plugins.name: webhook-providers
plugins.description: One skill per webhook sender: its signature scheme, events, retries and pitfalls, every fact dated and sourced from the sender's own docs, with tested Node.js, Python and C# handlers.
